Chapter 1 - The Hunt: Digital Danger

Mikey began preparing for another long day of work, made longer by the fact his only true friend at Hest, Tim, was working from home. Mikey knew that it was his decision to have Tim work the side-project today, it was becoming more important since Hest kept pushing the research team to finish Project Hijack sooner and sooner. This didn't anger Mikey, he was already pouring his heart into this project, and having Hest push the other researchers made his job easier, he didn't have to do any management. It did mean that Project Hijack was nearly complete - and it showed. The device was nearly complete. It had become bigger and bigger - the amount of energy it required was titanic; the more data there is to 'hijack,' the more energy, and the bigger the device needed to be. It wasn't the ideal version of his creation, but Hest wanted it by the end of the month, and he could always work with the hardware engineers later to shrink it down. It was nearly complete, and Mikey had a growing excitement to turn it on and watch it work. The energy put him into a catatonic-coding state, so focused, he almost didn't even notice the gunfire...

Hest Laboratories, the research lab where Mikey worked, was under siege. Mikey could hear the gunfire ringing throughout the building, but he was too close. His creation was almost complete, and he wasn't about to leave his work unfinished. Most of his research team was already in panic or fleeing, but Mikey stayed at his computer, hacking away. The gunfire was getting closer, but so was his progress - some of the code was shifty, but it would work for a final test run. He began the build, the final task before he could test his machine, usually these builds took about 5 boring, reddit-surfing minutes, but it was clear to Mikey the next 5 minutes would probably be the most interesting of his life. He began grabbing whatever large objects he could and placed them in front of the lab's doors, doing anything to buy him more time. With 30 seconds remaining, there was a three loud bangs at the door. "This is S.H.I.E.L.D, open this door or we will forcefully enter." There was a lot about what Mikey had just heard that he wanted to contemplate, but there was too little time and too much research at stake to worry about that now. He quickly made up a lie to stall while he prepped the device, "Yep, cool, I understand, totally, just... undoing the locking mechanism, it's quite complicated you see... theres-" An explosion at the door interrupted him, but Mikey had bought enough time - the build was done. The air was heavy with smoke from the bomb, but Mikey was able to turn the device on. As it began spinning into action, the the S.H.I.E.L.D agent sprang into action and began running towards Mikey, who was standing right next to the device. As Mikey put his hands up, one of the agents tackled him into the device, sending a visible electric charge that struck Mikey, who quickly blacked out...

When Mikey awoke he was sitting, handcuffed to a metal chair in a small, boxy interrogation room. He was alone, but he knew he was being watched. He was a defeated man in chains, lonely, and his life's work likely destroyed. A splitting headache left him mentally drained, and all he could think about was Tim, who he loved, but he never had the balls to tell him and then Mikey blinked...

Mikey's headache became something more, it felt as if it had opened up and drained into infinity. He felt as if every piece of himself was picked apart. This feeling lasted only a split second during his blink, the headache began to subside as if the pieces of himself were being caught and reassembled. And then he opened his eyes. He was not in the interrogation room anymore, no, he was at Tim's apartment. "How can this be??", he felt different, slightly smaller. He looked down and was shocked that he was wearing different clothing, comfortable loungewear. Then an impossible idea crept upon him. He quickly headed for the bathroom and looked in the mirror. His reflection affirmed the impossibility - Mikey was inside of Tim. Or at least that was his current theory. The situation was making him very horny and very confused. He was the object of his affection. He felt like he had entered his fantasy and was going crazy at the same time. He knew he needed to find out where the real Tim had gone, but he also wanted to make the most of the moment. As he began to contemplate the complex morality of relieving 'Tim's' gargantuan erection, there was a knock at the door. Mikey looked through the peephole and saw Derek, the local drug dealer. "I got bud for ya, bud" said Derek, he was shirtless and lived just down the hall. As Mikey began to open the door, he thought about how attractive Derek was and he blinked...

The feeling of being split into a thousand pieces only to be reassembled overcame Mikey again, and when he opened his eyes, a familiar scene awaited him. One thing was off though, he was now on the other side of the opening door, and feeling slightly cold. He gathered that he had probably become Derek. Mikey began to question if he had died and gone to heaven, or if this was some cruel fate that he would eternally swap with whoever he looked at. So when the door opened he was ready to read the expression of his friend 'Tim.' Much to Mikey's relief he saw the same look of shock he felt when he went through a swap. "Who are you?" Mikey asked. Tim began to stammer "Uh, I'm Tim, you know me Derek, do you have the weed?" Mikey was relieved that it was Tim and not Derek, although that drew forth a whole new set of uneasy questions. Mikey shoved his way into Tim's apartment. "Hey, what are you doing?!" Tim exclaimed. "Hold up, hold up, I'm Mikey, there was an raid at the lab and something weird happened, and now I'm swapping bodies left and right!" - "Mikey!?" exclaimed Tim. "Yes!" - "Oh thank god, I'm not the only crazy one around here. I just spent time being interrogated about the device, and they were calling me Mikey." As Tim and Mikey began to comb over previous events, they worked out that whenever Mikey did a swap, his body acted as a "hub" where the person who was being swapped into would go. "That means poor Derek is being interrogated for something he doesn't even know about, bro." Mikey said with a somber expression. "Did you just say bro, Mikey? You never say bro." replied Tim, "Regardless, it is probably for the best that he is being interrogated, and not us - imagine if S.H.I.E.L.D knew about this, then what would happen?" Mikey knew Tim was right, and the fact that he used the word bro was out of character, but it felt right. Mikey had a feeling he was unintentionally adapting to Derek's personality. "You know what would calm us down a bit, a joint" said Mikey. Tim and Mikey, now Derek, took rolled a joint and they took turns passing it while relaxing on the sofa...

End Chapter 1
